### [`clear_space_sparkle`](../../../../src/screen/space_sparkle.asm#L6) `$77D1`

*routine*

Clears rows 0 and 4 of the four space characters $60, $61, $70 and $71. The cave set-up calls it.

- **Called from:** [`init_game_vars`](../init/init_vars.md#init_game_vars) [`$8E2A`](../../../../src/init/init_vars.asm#L57)
- **Writes:** [`gfx_space_tl`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_tl), [`gfx_space_tl+4`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_tl), [`gfx_space_tr`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_tr), [`gfx_space_tr+4`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_tr), [`gfx_space_bl`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_bl), [`gfx_space_bl+4`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_bl), [`gfx_space_br`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_br), [`gfx_space_br+4`](../../memory-map.md#gfx_space_br)

<a id="bonus_life_sparkle"></a>
### [`bonus_life_sparkle`](../../../../src/screen/space_sparkle.asm#L18) `$77EC`

*routine*

Bonus life sparkle: fills rows 0 and 4 of the space characters with random bytes and decrements bonus_life_timer. The last frame clears them. The screen drawing routine calls it while bonus_life_timer is not 0. add_bonus_life sets the timer to $80.
